messages.subject: Parallel Processing in tidyLPA?
messages.body_plain: Thanks for this great package! I already used it for a somewhat small sample. Now, however, I would like to apply LPA to a sample of millions of cases which takes a lot of time in R. Would it be possible to implement parallel processing into tidyLPA?
